overview.description: The Direxion Daily BABA Bull 2X ETF (BABU) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Alibaba Group Holding Limited index. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. (BABA). BABU was launched on Feb 11, 2026 and is issued by Direxion.
